article.headline: Emmanuel Manyuon scores 22 to lead Marshall over Buffalo 92-65
article.description: — Emmanuel Manyuon had 22 points in Marshall's 92-65 victory over Buffalo on Monday in a season opener.
article.linkText: Emmanuel Manyuon scores 22 to lead Marshall over Buffalo 92-65

article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Emmanuel Manyuon had 22 points in Marshall's 92-65 victory over Buffalo on Monday in a season opener. Manyuon also contributed 11 rebounds for the Thundering Herd. Bryce Slay scored 19 points, going 8 of 12 from the field. Noah Otshudi had 16 points and shot 5 of 11 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line. Antoine Lorick led the way for the Bulls with 28 points and 15 rebounds. Drew Steffe added 19 points for Buffalo. Dylan Ducommun finished with nine points, two steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
